title: Treatment of Stable Both-Bone Midshaft Forearm Fractures in Children
brief_summary: We create a randomized clinical trial between the treatment with above elbow armcast alone and the treatment of above elbow in combination with a short arm cast for stable midshaft both-bone forearm fractures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* both-bone forearm fracture
* age \< 16 years
* dislocation
* stable

Exclusion Criteria:

* fracture older than 1 week
* no informed consent
* refracture
* open fracture (Gustillo 2 and 3)
